description: This file defines a React component 'TabbedUserModal' which displays user details and associated projects in a modal dialog. It includes subcomponents for rendering user details and projects, and manages tab switching between these views. It also imports external UI components and hooks, and uses PropTypes for type checking.

methods.name: UserDetailsView
methods.description: A React functional component that displays user details such as name, email, department, and tenant in a styled grid.

methods.name: UserProjectsView
methods.description: A React functional component that fetches and displays a list of projects associated with a user, including handling loading and error states.

methods.name: TabbedUserModal
methods.description: Main React component that renders a modal with tabs for user details and projects, managing tab state and rendering respective views.
